args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after deploying v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Monitoring continues.

trace.final:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.

Note: I did not deploy v2.3.1-rc (staging, unhealthy) — the rollback target was the last healthy production release, v2.3.0, per the request.
